# Templates

Starting points for new pages. Copy one, replace the parts in angle brackets, and delete any section that doesn't
apply. [Writing the docs](../writing-docs.md) says where each kind of page goes.

| Template | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| [App section](app-section.md) | A new app, as a section in its group's page in `apps/` |
| [Guide page](guide-page.md) | A new subject in `guide/` that works across apps |
| [Decision record](adr.md) | A new architecture decision in `adr/` |
